original_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, full-body character turnaround.
Create ONE high-definition character sheet containing exactly THREE full-length views of the SAME adult heroine: FRONT, TRUE 90-DEGREE SIDE profile facing image-left, and BACK, arranged left to right in one horizontal row. Each view must include complete crown-to-boot-soles, with comfortable white margins, same standing scale, same floor baseline, same crown height, same knee height and identical body proportions. Target landscape canvas 2172 x 1448 pixels, 3:2 aspect ratio, crisp fine detail.

Image 1 is the EXACT APPROVED SINGLE FULL-BODY MASTER, and has priority for pose, leg shape, proportions, outfit, lengths and silhouette. Reproduce its front view faithfully as the left figure; do not change the selected narrow parallel stance, kneecaps, leg spacing or head size. Derive anatomically coherent side and rear views of this exact person and exact outfit. Her adult identity: ash-blonde long softly wavy side-parted hair, cool fair skin, gray-green eyes, same delicate refined face and earrings. Tall slender balanced fashion proportions, natural neck and shoulders, relaxed arms at sides with real hands, slim natural legs, forward-facing knees and grounded feet. Side view is an unambiguous anatomical profile, pelvis and knees comfortably straight, no twist or arch; rear view directly from behind with matching limb alignment.

OUTFIT MUST MATCH master exactly in ALL views: opaque dusty blue-gray fine vertical ribbed sleeveless A-line above-knee dress, hem approximately 10 cm above kneecaps (same garment length front/side/back), bare legs NO tights, long open taupe coat with subtle jacquard pattern, lapels and pockets, hem below knees, same taupe leather heeled ankle boots. The coat remains LONGER than the dress. In side and back views the long coat naturally occludes much of the short dress, do not invent a blue midi skirt protruding below the coat. Rear coat is closed fabric across back, with natural center-back seam and vent if needed, no invented open gap to show dress. Same hair length/volume from behind flowing across upper back; consistent coat lapels, cuff/hem heights and heel dimensions across views.

White seamless studio backdrop, soft neutral consistent studio lighting, premium semi-realistic otome 2.5D/3D CG like master, sharp face/individual hair strands, clean dress ribbing and coat weave, natural bare skin and boot leather detail. Consistency and full-body scale are essential. No head closeups, no bust views, no expressions, no extra characters, no contact sheet of nine, no text/labels/borders/watermarks, no accessories added. One three-view full-body sheet only.
